penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: A self-hosted PHP/MySQL FAQ engine is a software product, not a service — it requires ongoing development, bug fixing, security patching, and feature work that cannot be automated by Claude prompts. Delivering and maintaining a software product is inherently human-touch.

rationale: The buyer (IT manager / developer at an SMB) is identifiable but is explicitly seeking free or low one-off cost software — the willingness_to_pay signal is weak, and the market signal is from a single forum post about a niche self-hosted stack. Building and maintaining a PHP FAQ engine is a software product development effort that requires ongoing coding, bug fixes, and security patches — none of which Claude can do autonomously. This is the wrong shape of opportunity for this factory entirely.
solution_plan: Not recommended for build. This would require building and maintaining a custom PHP/MySQL web application — a full software product with a codebase that needs ongoing development, security patching, and support. That is not something a solo non-technical operator using Claude prompts + a landing page + Stripe can deliver. The buyer also signals strong price sensitivity ('free or low one-off cost'), making the economics unattractive even if the build problem were solvable.
notes: Fails buildability_with_ai (3 < 6 min) and operational_autonomy (3 < 7 min). Drop.
